<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
resolve_family(config: ModelConfig, family: str | None = None) -> FamilySpec
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.families`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/)

Resolve the family implementation for `config`, honouring an override.

The one place the package turns "a config plus an optional family key" into
a `FamilySpec`; `evoxc_hf.load`, `evoxc_hf.program` and
`evoxc_hf.pipeline` all go through it so the disagreement rule can never
drift between the loading half and the compute half.

## Parameters

- `config` · `ModelConfig` — the parsed model config (its `family` attribute is the
  default).

- `family` · `str | None` — optional explicit family key; `None` means `config.family`.

## Returns

- `FamilySpec` — the family implementation for `config`.

## Raises

- `HFConfigError` — `family` disagrees with `config.family` (never
  silently re-interpret one config with another family's weight map).

- `HFUnsupportedError` — `family` (or `config.family`) is not a
  registered family.
